name: gradient-frozen-heat
title: Frozen Heat
description: A static gradient that reads as a heat-to-cold transition: rose-red on the left, periwinkle lavender through the middle, and light sky blue on the right, drawn across a wide rounded block.
use: A soft warm-to-cool wash should give a page or card a friendly gradient base.
avoid: The three stops and the diagonal angle are hardcoded, so a rebrand means editing the file.
a11y: No interactive parts, so keyboard, focus and labelling are not applicable. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. The left edge is a deep rose-crimson, the centre is a soft periwinkle, and the right side opens into a light sky blue, blended on a gentle diagonal.
behaves: Static: no motion or response; every frame carries the same rose-to-blue sweep.
customise: className and style change the size or override the gradient; the rose, periwinkle and blue stops sit in the source.
weight: light: A single div with a CSS gradient; nothing runs at runtime.
issues: Reported full-bleed footprint conflicts with the rounded inset panel seen in the frames.
polishWhy: Smooth blend and even corners; a competent but generic gradient swatch.
